newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek govt dismisses bourse cover up allegations.
newsitem.headline: Greek govt dismisses bourse cover up allegations.

text.p: Greece ordered national Economy Ministry inspectors to audit 10 brokerage firms involved in trades with Delta Securities which was charged with fraud, government spokesman Dimitris Reppas told reporters.
He did not specify which brokerages would be inspected.

"The government has nothing to fear and nothing to hide," Reppas said during a press briefing, referring to criticism by the brokers' association that a cover up of the bourse scandal was in the offing.
"Those responsible for fraud must and will be punished," Reppas said.
Greece's capital markets commission had also asked two U.S. auditing companies to conduct independent audits, he told reporters.

He said that presently the resignation of Athens bourse president, Mannolis Xanthakis, was not an issue. Both Prime Minister Costas Simitis and National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou were monitoring developments. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
